label: BigNum
description: Large, bold numeric data fields with optional HR and power zone coloring.
releaseNotes: Fourteen new fields: sunrise, sunset, the time of day, total ride time, time to destination, power as a % of FTP, lap max HR, battery, and smoothed speed and cadence at 3s, 5s and 10s. The HUD's zone bar is now a pill in the middle of the label row, showing your zone as squares you can count, or as a solid colour if you prefer. Labels sit higher and every number is drawn taller. Time - Elapsed is now called Time - Riding, since Total Time sits beside it.
